# tidbcloud_dedicated_changefeed (Resource)

dedicated changefeed resource manages a changefeed (CDC replication) of a TiDB Cloud Dedicated cluster. Only the `KAFKA` and `MYSQL` downstream types are supported for now. Editing the downstream configuration of a RUNNING changefeed automatically pauses it for the duration of the edit and resumes it afterwards (the API requires the PAUSED state for edits); replication catches up after the resume. A changefeed in the FAILED state rejects all modifications.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "kafka_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "mysql_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Replicate changes to Apache Kafka.
resource "tidbcloud_dedicated_changefeed" "kafka_example" {
  cluster_id           = "your_cluster_id"
  name                 = "changefeed-to-kafka"
  replication_capacity = "4rcu"
  downstream_type      = "KAFKA"

  network_info = {
    network_type = "NETWORK_TYPE_PUBLIC"
  }

  start_position = {
    mode = "FROM_NOW"
  }

  table_config = {
    filter_rules = ["mydb.*"]
  }

  kafka = {
    broker = {
      version          = "KAFKA_VERSION_3XX"
      broker_endpoints = "broker1:9092,broker2:9092"
    }
    authentication = {
      auth_type = "SASL_SCRAM_SHA_256"
      username  = "kafka_user"
      password  = var.kafka_password
    }
    data_format = {
      protocol = "PROTOCOL_CANAL_JSON"
    }
    topic_partition_config = {
      dispatch_type      = "DISPATCH_TYPE_ONE_TOPIC"
      default_topic      = "tidb-cdc"
      replication_factor = 3
      partition_num      = 6
    }
  }
}

# Replicate changes to a MySQL-compatible database.
resource "tidbcloud_dedicated_changefeed" "mysql_example" {
  cluster_id           = "your_cluster_id"
  name                 = "changefeed-to-mysql"
  replication_capacity = "4rcu"
  downstream_type      = "MYSQL"

  network_info = {
    network_type = "NETWORK_TYPE_PUBLIC"
  }

  start_position = {
    mode      = "FROM_TSO"
    start_tso = "457111558064308225"
  }

  mysql = {
    connection = {
      endpoint = "mysql.example.com:3306"
      username = "root"
      password = var.mysql_password
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster.
- `downstream_type` (String) The downstream type of the changefeed. Available values: `KAFKA`, `MYSQL`.
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the changefeed.
- `network_info` (Attributes) The network configuration for the downstream connection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_info))
- `replication_capacity` (String) The replication capacity (RCU) of the changefeed, for example `4rcu`. Changing it scales the changefeed.
- `start_position` (Attributes) The start position for the changefeed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--start_position))

### Optional

- `kafka` (Attributes) The Kafka downstream configuration. Required when `downstream_type` is `KAFKA`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kafka))
- `mysql` (Attributes) The MySQL downstream configuration. Required when `downstream_type` is `MYSQL`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mysql))
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the changefeed is paused.
- `table_config` (Attributes) The table filtering and event filter configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_config))

### Read-Only

- `changefeed_id` (String) The ID of the changefeed.
- `checkpoint_ts` (String) The checkpoint timestamp of the changefeed.
- `checkpoint_tso` (String) The checkpoint TSO of the changefeed.
- `create_time` (String) The creation time of the changefeed.
- `error` (String) The error message when the changefeed is in the `FAILED` or `ERROR` state.
- `state` (String) The current state of the changefeed.

<a id="nestedatt--network_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_info`

Required:

- `network_type` (String) The network type. Available values: `NETWORK_TYPE_PUBLIC`, `NETWORK_TYPE_VPC_PEERING`, `NETWORK_TYPE_PRIVATE_LINK`.

Optional:

- `ports` (List of Number) The downstream target ports for the `NETWORK_TYPE_PRIVATE_LINK` network type.
- `sink_endpoint_id` (String) The private endpoint ID configured in the TiDB Cloud console. Required for the `NETWORK_TYPE_PRIVATE_LINK` network type.


<a id="nestedatt--start_position"></a>
### Nested Schema for `start_position`

Required:

- `mode` (String) The start position mode. Available values: `FROM_NOW`, `FROM_TSO`, `FROM_UTC`.

Optional:

- `start_timestamp` (String) The start UTC timestamp in RFC 3339 format. Required when the mode is `FROM_UTC`.
- `start_tso` (String) The start TSO. Required when the mode is `FROM_TSO`.


<a id="nestedatt--kafka"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kafka`

Required:

- `authentication` (Attributes) The Kafka authentication configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kafka--authentication))
- `broker` (Attributes) The Kafka broker connection configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kafka--broker))
- `data_format` (Attributes) The data format and serialization configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kafka--data_format))
- `topic_partition_config` (Attributes) The topic and partition configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kafka--topic_partition_config))

Optional:

- `column_selectors` (Attributes List) The column selectors for filtering specific columns. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kafka--column_selectors))

<a id="nestedatt--kafka--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kafka.authentication`

Required:

- `auth_type` (String) The Kafka authentication type. Available values: `DISABLE`, `SASL_PLAIN`, `SASL_SCRAM_SHA_256`, `SASL_SCRAM_SHA_512`.

Optional:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) The SASL password for Kafka authentication. This field is input-only and never returned by the API.
- `username` (String) The SASL username for Kafka authentication.


<a id="nestedatt--kafka--broker"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kafka.broker`

Required:

- `version` (String) The Kafka broker version. Available values: `KAFKA_VERSION_0XX`, `KAFKA_VERSION_1XX`, `KAFKA_VERSION_2XX`, `KAFKA_VERSION_3XX`.

Optional:

- `broker_endpoints` (String) The comma-separated list of Kafka broker addresses. Required for the `NETWORK_TYPE_PUBLIC` and `NETWORK_TYPE_VPC_PEERING` network types.
- `compression` (String) The Kafka message compression type. Available values: `NONE`, `GZIP`, `SNAPPY`, `LZ4`, `ZSTD`.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Whether to skip TLS certificate verification.
- `use_tls` (Boolean) Whether to use TLS for the Kafka connection.


<a id="nestedatt--kafka--data_format"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kafka.data_format`

Required:

- `protocol` (String) The Kafka output protocol. Available values: `PROTOCOL_CANAL_JSON`, `PROTOCOL_OPEN_PROTOCOL`, `PROTOCOL_DEBEZIUM`. (`PROTOCOL_AVRO` is not supported by this resource yet.)

Optional:

- `debezium_config` (Attributes) The Debezium-specific configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kafka--data_format--debezium_config))
- `enable_tidb_extension` (Boolean) Whether to enable TiDB extension fields.
- `output_raw_change_event` (Boolean) Whether to output raw change events.

<a id="nestedatt--kafka--data_format--debezium_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kafka.data_format.debezium_config`

Optional:

- `disable_schema` (Boolean) Whether to disable the schema in Debezium messages.
- `output_old_value` (Boolean) Whether to output the old value before the change.



<a id="nestedatt--kafka--topic_partition_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kafka.topic_partition_config`

Required:

- `dispatch_type` (String) The message dispatch type to topics. Available values: `DISPATCH_TYPE_ONE_TOPIC`, `DISPATCH_TYPE_BY_TABLE`, `DISPATCH_TYPE_BY_DATABASE`.
- `partition_num` (Number) The number of partitions for auto-created topics.
- `replication_factor` (Number) The replication factor for auto-created topics.

Optional:

- `default_topic` (String) The default topic for dispatching all messages when `dispatch_type` is `DISPATCH_TYPE_ONE_TOPIC`.
- `partition_dispatchers` (Attributes List) The custom partition dispatcher configurations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kafka--topic_partition_config--partition_dispatchers))
- `separator` (String) The separator between the prefix and the table or database name.
- `topic_prefix` (String) The topic name prefix for dispatch types that create per-table or per-database topics.
- `topic_suffix` (String) The topic name suffix for dispatch types that create per-table or per-database topics.

<a id="nestedatt--kafka--topic_partition_config--partition_dispatchers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kafka.topic_partition_config.partition_dispatchers`

Required:

- `partition_type` (String) The partition dispatch strategy.

Optional:

- `columns` (List of String) The column names for the `COLUMNS` partition dispatcher.
- `index_name` (String) The index name for the `INDEX_VALUE` partition dispatcher.
- `matcher` (List of String) The table name patterns to match for the dispatcher.



<a id="nestedatt--kafka--column_selectors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kafka.column_selectors`

Optional:

- `columns` (List of String) The column names to include for the matched tables.
- `matcher` (List of String) The table name patterns to match for column selection.



<a id="nestedatt--mysql"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mysql`

Required:

- `connection` (Attributes) The MySQL connection configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mysql--connection))

<a id="nestedatt--mysql--connection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mysql.connection`

Required:

- `username` (String) The MySQL username for authentication.

Optional:

- `endpoint` (String) The MySQL endpoint address in the `host:port` format. Required for the `NETWORK_TYPE_PUBLIC` and `NETWORK_TYPE_VPC_PEERING` network types.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The MySQL password for authentication. This field is input-only and never returned by the API.



<a id="nestedatt--table_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_config`

Optional:

- `case_sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the filter rules are case-sensitive.
- `event_filters` (Attributes List) The event filter rules for fine-grained control. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_config--event_filters))
- `filter_rules` (List of String) The table filter rules. Uses the TiCDC table filter syntax.
- `mode` (String) The mode for handling unsupported tables. Available values: `IGNORE_NOT_SUPPORT_TABLE`, `FORCE_SYNC`.

<a id="nestedatt--table_config--event_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_config.event_filters`

Optional:

- `ignored_delete_value_expression` (String) The SQL expression to filter DELETE events by column value.
- `ignored_events` (List of String) The event types to ignore.
- `ignored_insert_value_expression` (String) The SQL expression to filter INSERT events by column value.
- `ignored_sql_statements` (List of String) The SQL statement patterns to ignore (DDL only). Supports regular expressions.
- `ignored_update_new_value_expression` (String) The SQL expression to filter UPDATE events by the new column value.
- `ignored_update_old_value_expression` (String) The SQL expression to filter UPDATE events by the old column value.
- `table_matchers` (List of String) The table name patterns to match. Uses the TiCDC table filter syntax.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a dedicated changefeed by its changefeed ID.
terraform import tidbcloud_dedicated_changefeed.example <changefeed_id>
```
